question: Oda-sensei, I have a question. Those who ate SMILEs grow horns, right? Then why do Pleasures have one horn and Gifters two horns? – 10
answer: So you noticed that, huh. That's just fashion! It's not enforced, but Pleasures are allowed to sport one horn, while Gifters and above are allowed two, or so the rule goes.
name: Hadokku 10
